cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm lifting this end the way you did. Take the other end; let's move the table together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only lifted it to check the loose leg. It will fall off if we carry it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, checking together. Help me tighten it, then. You don't need to do the whole job for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hold the leg straight. You turn the screw until it grips.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this is our repair. Keep holding while I do my half.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies a test lift as moving; A3 calls it shared checking and asks for help rather than rescue; A5 calls B4 divided work our repair but does little to redefine an established relationship.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 loose leg causes A3 tightening plan; B4 holding/screwing division supplies A5 my half.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers a workable division of labor without taking over.

heightening.evidence: A5 mostly describes the help B4 already offered, rather than making its manner change what the relationship means.

specificity.evidence: A1 table and B2 loose leg establish the need; B4 tools and roles are explicit.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 our repair is short but close to a label of the mechanism.
